protocol.reference_source: Analytical noiseless ferro, period-four antiphase, plus-product and maximally mixed controls, not fitted phase labels
protocol.normalization: Fixed analytic scales 1, 1/2, 1; self correlations retained
protocol.distance: Euclidean, equal feature weights; all four controls included
protocol.wavevector_folding: average m(k) and m(N-k), preserving amplitude; report both partner indices
protocol.peak_intervals: derivative: neighboring h nodes; chiF: supporting original h interval; grid resolution only
protocol.phase_claim: No thermodynamic phase or floating-phase confirmation; prototype output is a control resemblance diagnostic

cache_source: Read-only original baseline NPZ; validated shapes, FFT identity, h_mid and h=0 missingness
model: periodic H=-sum ZZ_nn+kappa sum ZZ_nnn-h sum X; all q include self correlations
basis_order: Wire 0 most significant bit, checked by main calibration tests; diagnostics use existing observables
